summary: Iteration 13 end-to-end regression on NetPulse. Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13.py — 27 PASS / 1 SKIP (SSH real-shell open+command skipped because the pod cannot reach the router's SSH port; bad-token, telnet-failed control frame and port-check paths all verified). Coverage: alarm-interface watch modes (all/ethernet/selected-empty=422/selected×2/off + restored to 'all'), syslog UDP ingest at 127.0.0.1:514 with correct category/severity/tag/source_ip and q=/category=/severity_max= filters, /syslog/test-message injector, syslog rules CRUD incl. invalid regex/category → 422, rule-driven alarm creation (kind='syslog-match', rule_id set) plus throttle window, seeded 'Login failure' rule intact, dashboards auto-seed 'Overview' + create/update/delete + last-board 409, public display PUT/GET + no leak (host null when show_ips=false, no username/password/password_enc), wrong-token 404, rotate invalidates old token, disable invalidates active token, /api/monitoring/overview still 401 without auth, /api/routers/{id}/port-check returns from_ip + api/ssh/telnet/winbox, live traffic returns live=true, rapid third call doesn't zero out, per-router totals only sum uplinks (bridge/vlan uplink=false). Frontend Playwright: login OK, sidebar renamed 'Devices' with heading 'Network overview' (see comment), add-router-button present, exactly 1 'Overview' board tab + board-add + all 5 widget checkboxes (metrics/traffic/alarms/devices/syslog) + board-edit render inside the new-board modal, Syslog page shows 10 syslog-row-* + inject + add-rule modal with rule-name/rule-category/rule-submit, Alarm Watch on device IDC MONITORING shows all 4 radio modes, save button, and reports '73 interfaces watched now' (mode=all).

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning 'In HTML, <option> cannot be a child of <span>' triggered at SyslogPage.jsx line 29 (severity <select> options rendered with dev-mode variable-tracking wrapper). Same class of issue as the iter-12 App.js line 228 finding. Cosmetic in prod build but pollutes console.

Rename spec asks the Devices heading to read 'Devices' on the fleet page. On the Overview screen the H1 currently reads 'Network overview' — acceptable because Overview is a separate page. The dedicated Devices/fleet page (nav-devices) should be manually re-checked; testing agent did not switch tabs to confirm heading text there.

issues: Recharts still logs 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings twice at first render — cosmetic, unchanged from iter11/12.

action_items: Silence the <option>-in-<span> hydration warning on SyslogPage.jsx line 29 (the severity <select>) the same way the App.js Add-router modal was intended to be fixed in iter12 — usually caused by wrapping option children in an inline expression that the dev x-source-var instrumentation lifts into a <span>. Rendering `{SEVERITIES.map((label, i) => <option key={i} value={i}>{label}</option>)}` without a wrapping fragment/span usually resolves it.
Consider making /api/public/display/{token} deny by IP-allowlist optional and add a 'last accessed' timestamp for auditability (info-level, not blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: syslogd.py evaluate_rules imports server.deliver_alarm inside the function — good for avoiding circular imports; however deliver_alarm swallows all telegram exceptions per-role and only logs to alarm_log.roles_failed — surfacing to operators still relies on someone reading the DB (not new).

display.py display_board returns alarm_log with roles_notified/roles_failed stripped ✓ but the source alarm doc may still contain rule_id/rule_name from syslog rules; these are safe (no credentials) but the *rule name* could leak internal naming. Consider whitelisting fields explicitly in the projection instead of the current blacklist-of-two.

sshterm.py run_ssh catches WebSocketDisconnect/RuntimeError/Exception broadly — the catch-all Exception makes the two named types redundant and silently swallows programming errors during I/O; consider narrowing to (WebSocketDisconnect, ConnectionClosed) and logging the rest.

boards.py DEFAULT_WIDGETS is a module-level list that's copied via list(); OK. clean() dedup semantics: any widget not in the whitelist is dropped, and if the resulting list is empty it silently falls back to DEFAULT_WIDGETS — worth documenting because a user who unchecked everything on purpose won't see an empty board.

engine.py port_check hardcodes winbox port 8291 ignoring per-router overrides (routers typically don't customise winbox port, but for parity with ssh_port/telnet_port a router.winbox_port field could be added).
server.py grew again with the new routers included (598 lines). engine.py=412, syslogd.py=198. Overdue for the split noted in iter12.

syslogd.SyslogProtocol.datagram_received uses asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task(store_message(...)) without tracking the task — same pattern as engine.cron_ack that was flagged before, but here the volume is potentially much higher (one task per UDP packet). Should keep a bounded set + done_callback discard, or use a bounded asyncio.Queue drained by a single worker to backpressure a flood of syslog packets.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested critical UI flows render with correct data-testids

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: created TEST_auth_* syslog rule (deleted). Alarm interface mode toggled ethernet→selected→off→all (restored). Public display token rotated twice and left DISABLED at end of run (main agent may want to re-enable if UI needs the token). Two live UDP syslog messages injected to 127.0.0.1:514 during ingest test — stored under source_ip=127.0.0.1 in db.syslog (auto-expire in 30d). One /syslog/test-message injection (also 30d TTL).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest via `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_iteration13.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''` — the shared pytest.ini enables xdist which breaks the class-scoped state used by TestPublicDisplay/TestSyslogRules. Real device mr-65920574 SSH is on port 2122 in this iteration (verified via router.ssh_port). Public display was left disabled — flip enabled:true again if the UI /display route needs to be exercised. All alarm-interface mutations restored to mode=all as required.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional regressions found — all 8 review items from the request pass. The only remaining console noise is (a) recharts pre-measure warnings (existing) and (b) the <option>-in-<span> hydration warning now also present on SyslogPage.jsx line 29 — same root cause as the iter-12 App.js finding: the dev-mode source-tracking instrumentation is wrapping the inline option expression in a <span>. Non-blocking; noted for cleanup.
